datasets.name: failed_agent_cases
queryLines:
SELECT
  created_at,
  case_id,
  scenario_type,
  failure_reasons,
  judge_rationale,
  trace_id
FROM
  payments_dev.analytics.agent_quality_base
WHERE
  case_pass = false
ORDER BY
  created_at DESC

lines: Fraud probability and predicted fraud are model signals used for prioritization and investigation. They are not confirmed fraud outcomes.
